revision.scope:
ONE new bounded complete-path algorithm with flexible monotone descent.

Unlike406's exact linear normal-gap profile, the four interior post-hover
phase coordinates are free cumulative positive increments. Original gap ordering,
normal speed and planning bounds remain hard. A fraction-to-boundary predictor
retains1% of each current signed hard/coordinate margin, then bounded actual
nonlinear backtracking verifies feasibility. This changes step construction, not
any physical acceptance threshold. All geometric/load/phase/timing coordinates
vary jointly. Integer budget proposals get only a full trial; fractional trials
are allowed only when all five integer budgets are unchanged.

ONE algorithm: maximum16 MILP subproblems,60s/1000nodes each; at most8 nonlinear
fractions per unchanged-budget proposal,128 total. All accepted trials must retain
original strict hard rows, bounds and hover plus positive soft-merit reduction.
No extension, previous-solve polishing, runtime, physics or policy updates.
revision.merit: maximum normalized violation of only command/rate/headroom/window rows; no slack on original hard rows
revision.hard_actual_acceptance: every retained signed hard row >=0; constructed hover abs(eq)<=unchanged1e-8; physical admission still separate
